roles.name: 运行时与内存
roles.goal: R1-M1-OWNER-LOAN-STOP-INTEGRATION-009: Under existing owner runtime/memory paths only, harden ScopedOwner/RetiredScope/FrozenRecord buffer lifetime during actual ready-batch loan, delayed return, Stop and rotation, including 0/1/32/33 borrowed TX/RX and two independent generations. Prove that Stop blocks fresh offers but never frees an outstanding driver-held handle, old callback never enters new owner and new ready fresh is not held behind retiring old loan. No crypto, Go admission, public ABI, driver socket or claimed authenticated origin.
roles.done_when: Preserve previous 75/75 scoped r1 native; add smallest necessary owner-local counterexamples for held frozen handles, late borrow/drop, idempotent Stop, generation ABA and bounded return backlog under two generations, plus explicit noncopy baseline where observable. Source-exact native worker compiled-once SUCCESS, evidence S/cursor-only H own Governance SUCCESS, no new root CI/shared API and no fake real Go V4/500Mbps. If existing code already proves an invariant, cite passing tests instead of duplicating a feature.

roles.name: 恢复与反馈
roles.goal: R2-M2-BOUNDED-TIMER-BURST-007: In wbd-recovery pure owner state only, establish whether receipt/repair shadow hard-expiry and grant deadlines can process a 10k-due candidate burst after monotonic clock jump without full-table scans per callback, counterfeit receipt, fresh HOL or unbounded retained state. Bound candidate output to 32 per poll and preserve hard expiry, old epoch debt, sparse absolute quota and no same-evidence second retry. No socket, Go auth, engine hooks or production P0 throughput claim.
roles.done_when: Preserve previous 44/44 R2 native; add source-exact fake monotonic 0/1/32/33 and 10k burst/expiry tests with counted inspections or clear operation bounds, plus stale generation/late completion and new fresh budget independent tests. Fix only a demonstrated R2-owned scheduling issue, avoid new generic scheduler if existing index suffices; one compiled-once native result and own evidence S/cursor-only H Governance SUCCESS. Record CPU/alloc if truly instrumented, not estimate; no synthetic-auth-as-live admission.

roles.name: 编码与数据保护
roles.goal: R1-M3-FEC-STEADY-COST-RELEASE-014: Under owned codec test paths, separate steady pre-existing real AEAD+unique PN postauth FEC BlockID/Heavy/Compact cost from the previously measured Debug fresh-owner-construction overhead; run source-locked release native >=1s warmup+3 repetitions for 192/896B, independent lane/tunnel directional synthetic test-only provenance, no production positive FecOrigin.
roles.done_when: Keep previous96/96 r1 native cases and repeat 2×2 scope adversarial cases, prove no cross-scope replay/expiry; release-mode own compiled-once benchmark evidence with clear steady-vs-construction ratio and CPU/p99 semantics, no production V4/ISA-L/500Mbps extrapolation; own S then cursor-only H Governance.

roles.name: 平台与产品接入
roles.goal: R1-M4-DRIVER-OUTCOME-LEASE-009: Under existing wbd-platform/r1+Linux owned paths only, connect bounded frozen-ready caller-owned buffers to unprivileged actual kernel UDP send/receive outcome and explicit BorrowFence STOP lifecycle. Prove 0/1/32/33 accepted-prefix/uncertain/suffix mapping, truncated and WouldBlock/EINTR retry boundaries, idempotent STOP, generation-tagged late completion, and no free while kernel/driver still holds a lease. Keep AF_PACKET isolated loopback capability-gated NOT_RUN if unprivileged; no ambient/physical sniffing, no Go V4, engine dependency or root ABI edits.
roles.done_when: Preserve previous64/64 native; add minimal non-duplicated source-attested unprivileged real-kernel UDP 0/1/32/33 and delayed stop/completion tests with exact outcome vs uncertain semantics, bounded<=32 preallocated handles, no new hot copies; retain EPERM negative and explicitly mark privileged RAW_RX_NOT_RUN unless observed. Own source-exact compiled-once native evidence S, cursor-only H Governance SUCCESS. Avoid generic or production raw driver while V4 auth still disconnected.
